title: 2026 Reunion - Group Panel: Leadership at Markel Group
description:
On this year's Markel Group panel at the 2026 Reunion, we welcomed the leaders of two of our Markel Ventures businesses, and the CEO of Markel Insurance. Andrew Crowley (President of Markel Ventures) moderated the panel with Simon Wilson (CEO, Markel Insurance), Ross DeBolt (CEO, Parkland Ventures), and Kyle Norton (President, Cottrell).

Markel Group’s businesses look and operate differently. Speakers explore how shared values, autonomy, and trust - rather than central control - enable these diverse operations to thrive independently, without a master script, just capable people, clear incentives, and a long‑term view.

Learn more about the Reunion at MKLReunion.com
